purpose: Cheap structural check that rotating late-band encounter grammars can expose different Lv31 class strengths/weaknesses before a dynamic repeated-miss probe.
boundary: One successful Lv31 P×P final is applied to a representative pressure snapshot.
This is not exact Stage48/49 authoring, not a clear-rate model, and not a replacement for the temporal probe.
Tank control value is underrepresented because the proxy reports immediate kill/remnant state rather than future time gained by knockback/barrier.
SPLITTER child chronology is not expanded here; it remains a targeted dynamic watch.

Tank.note: control/knockback value not represented by kill count
survivors are displaced/controlled in real temporal model

interpretation.LINE_ESCORT: Archer/Knight premium reset; Mage must rely on placement/timing rather than generic full-screen clear.
interpretation.CLUSTER_CASCADE: Mage premium reset; Rogue projectile storm and Tank global control also perform strongly; Archer leaves off-line bodies.
interpretation.FRONTLINE_BREACH: Knight/Mage immediate damage performs strongly; Tank value is primarily future control; Rogue/Archer do not erase all durable bodies.
interpretation.DURABLE_SCATTER: All classes retain pressure; Archer/Mage cannot solve wide scatter through their preferred geometry, while Rogue/Knight remove more but not necessarily all future pressure.

next: dynamic repeated-miss rotation probe before any Stage48-49 numeric freeze
